benchmarks.note: Land benchmarks: adjusted in-zone residential ¥/tsubo by station, triangulated from MLIT transaction data via Utinokati (2023–2025 / multi-year) with 2026 official land-price points (Tochidai / Tochi-d): Oyama ~18 (raw catchment transactions 13.3 on 382 deals 2023–25, 12.8 multi-year, are NOT used — about 36% of classified city deals are urbanisation-control land at 6.7 and the average transacted lot is 136坪， so the raw average prices a market in-zone listings are not in; in-zone district transactions run 17.0–24.9 and 2026 official points 17–21 within ~2 km; the station-front official points at 43.6–45.6 and the commercial transaction average of 30.9 are commercial values and are rejected for residential), Mamada ~10 (transactions 8.6 on 183 deals; official total 9.74, 公示 10.86; station-front points 12.4–13.7 are the best streets, not the typical lot), Otabayashi ~7 as a low-confidence proxy (Tochidai's 12.04 average is rejected — its points sit in Oyama's Inuzuka/Nakakuki districts 3.2–3.7 km from Oyama station plus Yuki City; the only genuinely local official point is 6.84, flat for years; the station itself is in Yuki City, Ibaraki, serving Oyama's western fringe — Inuzuka/Nakakuki listings that name Otabayashi score against the Oyama-west band of ~16–17, not 7), Omoigawa ~4 (transactions 3.2 on just 16 deals; a single official point at 4.17, falling −1.56%/yr), Koganei ~8 as a proxy for Hagawa-district listings (transactions 6.7 on 50 deals; official 10.45; the station is in Shimotsuke City). Also rejected: Tochi-d's 2026 city 基準地価 average of 35.47, which rests on a single Arai point at 704.13 万円/坪， and a Totinokati series showing "小山 住宅地 29.1" — that is Natori City, Miyagi, not Oyama. Urbanisation-control land is scored only against control-zone comparables (city control average 6.7). Walk gradient is the flattest yet: about −5.6% per 10 minutes' walk on the city regression (transaction bands: ≤5 min 18.9 / 6–10 min 13.7 / 11–15 min 12.0 / 16+ min 10.7 — the raw band drop is zoning mix, not walking; the average transacted walk is 30.4 min). Used houses transacted at about ¥65万/tsubo city-wide (recent-3-year average, floor-area basis; Oyama station catchment 67.7, Mamada 56.3; districts 79–82 station-east/south down to 38.9 in the far west at Nakakuki). Official residential land prices rose +1.3% in the 2026 公示 survey — the fastest in Tochigi and the fifth straight rise — with commercial +2.0%; the growth is corridor-led and the Ryomo-line fringe is still falling.
